data.raw_text:
Downpour in Quezon City on Monday afternoon (June 23, 2025), resulting in flood and heavy traffic. Photos taken along Timog Avenue and Kamuning Road. 
DOST-PAGASA said the southwest monsoon (habagat) is affecting Metro Manila, Calabarzon, Bicol Region, Mimaropa, Western Visayas, Zamboanga Peninsula, Bangsamoro, Negros Occidental and the rest of Central Luzon.  At 3 p.m. a low-pressure area was estimated based on all available data at 185 km west of Cubi Pt. at Subic Bay International Airport in Bataan. | PNA photos by Robert Oswald P. Alfiler
